title: moe_gguf: reset KV cache on new sequence (input_pos==0)
goal: The shared ModelWeights handle is reused across requests, but the MoE backend's ConcatKvCache only ever appends — a second request's prefill sees stale KV and crashes with a mask shape mismatch (observed live: [1,32,614,840] vs [1,1,614,614]). Reset the per-layer kv_cache when input_pos==0, matching qwen2_split's reset-on-zero contract.
